page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: lia uocauerit, quòd pueros pro nummis aureis in episcopos constituerit, uirgines & peregrinas uio-lauerit, Lateranense palatium sacrum, lupanar ac proftibulum fecerit, quòd Stephanam patris sui concubinam, Raimeram uiduam, & Annam alium adhuc uiduam cum sua nepte constuprauerit, Benedictum patrem spiritualem luminibus priuauerit, uenationes publicas exercuerit, arma portauerit, incendia procurauerit, fores & fenestras nocte fregerit, diabolo uinum praebiberit, & se crucis signo nunquam muniuerit, cum multis aliis. Vnde ab ipso Cæsare consentientibus praelatis, depositus fuit, & Leo octauus in eius locum suffectus. Sed post eius decessum, mulieres meretrices illæ, cum quibus commercium habuerat, nobiles Romanos concitauerunt, promissis Ecclesiarum thesauris, ut Ioannem rursus in urbem susciperent. Quod & ipsi statim fecerunt, deiecto Leone, quem Cæsar creauerat. Constituit hic Papa, ut imperator Augustus, semper posthac a papa Romæ coronaretur. Dum uero quadam nocte extra Romam, anno decimo sui pontificatus, & anno Domini 964. cum cuiusdam strenui uiri uxore se oblectaret: ita est ab eo, pugione confossus, ut infra octiduum ex uulneribus moreretur, dignas scelera tissimæ uitæ das pœnas: ut et uitæ morib.exi

page.notes: The first word is a line fragment "lia" and stays as printed. The page number and running head are read from the scan and may be slightly blurred. The catchword "tus" sits at the lower right and completes "exitus". Some letters near the binding edge (right side, lines 'Benedictum' and 'Raimeram') are faint; readings are the most likely ones. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, as instructed. The line "Vnde ab ipso Cæsare" reads as printed; "Cæsar" is printed with long s.
